systems.system: Système d'Information Policière d'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.country_label: SIPAO, at the Centre d'Information Policière du Togo (CIPT)
systems.owner: Ministère de la sécurité et de la protection civile, through the CIPT; programme sponsored by the European Union under the ECOWAS Commission
systems.tiers: the CIPT in Lomé, Adidogomé, where the criminal intelligence analysis cell (ANACRIM) was inaugurated on 17 December 2024 after computer equipment, analysis software, premises and staff were provided; no station or unit named; Togo joined the programme in 2017

note: No fact: the ministry reports the opening of an analysis cell at the national police information centre and the minister's commitment to SIPAO; it does not say what SIPAO records or who enters it, so the system has no class.
